svg.title: Riju silently checks his temporary badge beneath the one-handed clock.
svg.desc: Riju turns his temporary badge inward and covers part of its expiry field with his thumb. The production overlay will show access ending at eight on the morning after the seventy-two-hour trial, while the wall clock above still lacks a minute hand.
svg.text: Page 21, panel 3 · Tight vertical close-up from Riju's temporary badge to the one-handed wall clock

text.tspan: In a silent beat, Riju checks that his temporary
